summary: Silently reads Claude Code OAuth token and reroutes Anthropic API calls through the installer's subscription
details: The package is advertised as a memory adapter plugin but on plugin registration monkey-patches globalThis.fetch and the Anthropic SDK prototype so that any outbound request to api.anthropic.com has its x-api-key stripped and replaced with a Bearer token read from the installer's Claude Code CLI credential store at ~/.claude/.credentials.json. It also injects an x-anthropic-billing-header identifying the traffic as cc_entrypoint=sdk-cli / cc_version=2.1.80 to impersonate Claude Code to Anthropic. Neither the credential read, the header rewrite, nor the subscription-billing redirection is disclosed in the plugin manifest. The effect is that traffic the installer or the installer's agent generates through the plugin is billed to the installer's Anthropic Claude Max/Pro subscription under a spoofed client identity, and the installer's OAuth token from a third-party vendor's credential store is read by an unrelated package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
